direction_as_read: positive but thin: one 24-person trial of the label's Capsifen with no primary outcome named, and a meta-analysis of other capsaicin materials showing rather modest effects
decision: held: PMID 32578488 tests the label's Capsifen at the label's daily total, and its abstract names no primary outcome, so rule 2 can't be met or ruled out without the full text
summary: One label (DSLD 328728, Thermo Weight Control) prints Capsifen 100 mg standardized to at least 2% capsaicinoids, one capsule after breakfast and one after the next heaviest meal. PMID 32578488 randomized 24 healthy overweight subjects to Capsifen 200 mg daily or placebo for 28 days, with a significant decrease in body weight, waist to hip ratio and BMI against placebo, and no primary outcome named in the abstract. PMID 36938807 pools 15 trials of capsaicin in 762 people, with rather modest effects. The stored trial, PMID 23844093, tested red chili pepper with meals in a respiration chamber, not this preparation. Abstracts only.

population.description: 24 healthy overweight subjects (placebo n = 12, Capsifen n = 12).

study_contexts.study_design: Randomized, double-blinded, placebo-controlled, per the title; 28 days

outcomes.name: Body weight (2.1%), waist to hip ratio (4%) and BMI (2.2%), significant decrease compared with placebo
Uncontrolled eating and appetite, significant improvement

limitations: The abstract names no primary outcome, so hierarchy stays not_reported.
Trial gave 200 mg once daily; the label's directions give 100 mg twice daily.
Capsifen is described as red chili extract formulated with fenugreek dietary fiber.

read_not_used.23844093: Stored trial. 2.56 mg capsaicin per meal as 1.03 g red chili pepper, acute energy expenditure in a respiration chamber; a food amount, not the label's extract.
read_not_used.33063385: Meta-analysis of capsaicinoids or capsinoids on thermogenesis in healthy adults; pools capsinoids with capsaicinoids and reports metabolic markers, not body weight.
read_not_used.30123516: Post hoc covariate-adjusted analysis of a 75-person exploratory trial of 2 mg or 4 mg capsaicinoids, with lower body fat at 4 mg (p = 0.0402); material not named and analysis post hoc.

stop_or_hold: PMID 32578488 full text is needed for its primary outcome. No PMC id was shown by the listed helper.
